stories.s: XBOW chained three Chrome bugs into a full‑chain exploit in six days with AI agents running OpenAI's GPT‑5.6, earning a $250,000 reward; all bugs were fixed in Chrome 152 releases.

stories.h: Hirudo Android banking trojan replaces eight Indonesian apps to bypass security checks
stories.s: ThreatFabric uncovered Hirudo, an Android trojan that swaps legitimate Indonesian banking apps with patched versions to evade built‑in security, distributing via dropper apps and fake Play Store pages.

stories.h: AI pentesting agent discovers critical OTP bypass on major insurer's website
stories.s: Reflectiz's AI agent found a critical authentication bypass allowing OTP delivery to arbitrary email addresses on a major insurer's production site during an authorized assessment.

stories.h: Linux vhost flaw (CVE-2026-74580) allows local user root and VM escape
stories.s: A local‑user vulnerability in Linux's vhost subsystem (CVE‑2026‑74580) lets an attacker read/write kernel memory and gain root, and in certain VM setups lets a guest hijack the host's QEMU process. Fixes are available in kernels 5.10.265 and later.

stories.h: Researchers demonstrate code execution in Windows SmartScreen VBS enclave (CVE-2026-83498)
stories.s: Security firm Doyensec showed a local four-byte write and timing bug lets code run inside the SmartScreen VBS enclave; Microsoft patched the issue in the September 8 2026 update (KB5124008).

stories.h: Microsoft seizes domains and disables 20,000 accounts linked to three Chinese phishing platforms
stories.s: Microsoft, with Japanese police and Health-ISAC, obtained a U.S. court order to take down YAM Store, CoGUI and Iron Man phishing platforms, redirecting domains and disabling over 20,000 accounts used in 750 million malicious messages.

stories.h: Collabora CODE app flaw exploited to plant web shells on Nextcloud servers
stories.s: Attackers leveraged CVE-2026-110447 in Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server to run unauthenticated commands and install PHP web shells on Nextcloud instances, with first attacks logged on September 10, 2026.

stories.h: Siemens issues 17 advisories, Rockwell patches critical ArmorBlock flaw in ICS Patch Tuesday
stories.s: Siemens released 17 new industrial‑control advisories covering critical flaws in Simatic CPUs and other products; Rockwell Automation issued an advisory fixing a critical unauthenticated password‑change bug in its 1732E ArmorBlock device.

stories.h: Kazakhstan-linked UAT-6275 targets CIS government agencies
stories.s: Cisco Talos and Recorded Future report UAT-6275 activity against government bodies in nine CIS countries, using macro docs, PowerShell and a FortiWeb exploit, with staging directories exposed on GitHub.

stories.h: Juniper Networks Junos OS suffers three CVE-2026 stack‑based buffer overflow flaws (CVSS 9.3)
stories.s: Three critical buffer‑overflow bugs (CVE‑2026‑101982, CVE‑2026‑102178, CVE‑2026‑101990) affect Juniper Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved, allowing remote BGP/EVPN peers to execute code or cause crashes via crafted route updates.

stories.h: Juniper Junos OS Evolved TACACS+ flaw (CVE-2026-102031) allows root command execution
stories.s: A CVSS 9.3 OS command injection in Juniper Networks Junos OS Evolved's TACACS+ lets a low‑privileged authenticated user run commands as root when authorization‑refresh is enabled.

stories.h: Juniper Junos OS sdxd daemon buffer overflow (CVE-2026-102175) rated CVSS 9.3
stories.s: A heap‑based buffer overflow in the sdxd service‑deployment daemon of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved can let an unauthenticated attacker execute code as root or cause denial‑of‑service via crafted TCP frames.

stories.h: Lantronix XPress-DR firmware missing auth allows config read/write via UDP
stories.s: A CVE-2026-109439 (CVSS 9.3) in Lantronix XPress-DR and XPress-DR-I firmware up to 8.1.0.0 lets unauthenticated attackers read and overwrite device configuration through UDP port 30718.

stories.h: Juniper Networks Junos OS J-Web Improper Authentication flaw (CVE-2026-101954) rated CVSS 9.3
stories.s: An unauthenticated attacker can gain root‑level device configuration via the J‑Web HTTP/HTTPS service when enabled, due to improper authentication in Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved.

stories.h: Microsoft uncovers Chinese-language phishing kit ecosystem selling tools to threat actors
stories.s: Microsoft detailed a Chinese-language phishing kit network sold via the YAM Store, enabling over one billion phishing emails and SMS to 75 thousand organizations worldwide across multiple sectors.

stories.h: Office-converter 1.0.2 suffers OS command injection (CVE-2020-37282)
stories.s: A CVSS 9.3 flaw in office-converter up to version 1.0.2 lets attackers execute arbitrary commands via crafted fileName in generatePdf() or generateHtml().

stories.h: OS command injection in pypdftk up to version 0.5 (CVE-2026-110636)
stories.s: pypdftk 0.5 allows OS command injection via fill_form(), dump_data_fields() and pdftk_cmd_util() when attacker controls pdf_path or out_file, executing commands through subprocess.Popen with shell=True.

stories.h: Juniper Networks Junos OS SRX Series SVR component buffer overflow (CVE-2026-101950)
stories.s: A heap‑based buffer overflow in the SVR component of Juniper Junos OS for SRX Series can be triggered by unauthenticated IPv4 packets, leading to denial‑of‑service and possible confidentiality/integrity compromise.

stories.h: UK sanctions crypto platform Cryptomus for facilitating Russian illicit payments
stories.s: The United Kingdom froze Cryptomus assets and banned British firms from dealing with it after the platform processed over $7 billion in illicit transactions linked to ransomware, narcotics and Russian government financing.

stories.h: Microsoft patches 1,415 flaws; one Windows Shell bug (CVE-2026-96951) actively exploited
stories.s: Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixed 1,415 vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-96951, a Windows Shell security feature bypass that is being exploited in the wild.

stories.h: Over 100 Azerbaijani government domains hit by foreign hacker group
stories.s: Since 22:00 on 13 Oct 2026, a foreign hacker group launched intensive attacks against more than 100 Azerbaijan state information infrastructure domains, causing temporary service interruptions.

stories.h: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS RCE zəifliyi (CVE-2026-0322) aktiv şəkildə istismar olunur, CISA KEV siyahısına əlavə edilib
stories.s: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS idarəetmə interfeyslərində autentifikasiya tələb edən yüksək ciddiyyətli uzaqdan kod icrası (RCE) zəifliyini (CVE-2026-0322, CVSS 8.6) açıqlayıb; məhdud istismar halları müşahidə olunub. CISA zəifliyi KEV kataloquna əlavə edərək, 17 oktyabr 2026-a qədər düzəlişlər edilməsinə çağırış edib.
stories.he: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS RCE flaw (CVE-2026-0322) actively exploited, added to CISA KEV

stories.h: Law enforcement disrupts cybercrime marketplace behind >1 billion phishing messages
stories.s: Global agencies, led by Microsoft and Japan's NPA, dismantled the YAM Store network that sent over 750 million phishing messages to Microsoft customers, seizing domains and 20,000 accounts.

stories.h: Cisco Secure Email Gateway zəifliyi (CVE-2026-76519) aktiv şəkildə istismar olunur, CISA KEV kataloquna əlavə edib
stories.s: Cisco Secure Email Gateway-də (CVE-2026-76519) kritik uzaqdan kod icrası zəifliyinin aktiv şəkildə istismar olunduğunu bildirib. Zəiflik File Reputation funksiyası aktiv olan və köhnə Content Scanner Tools quraşdırılmış cihazları təsirə məruz qoyur. Yamalar AsyncOS 15.5.5-014, 16.5.0-780 və skaner 25.3.0.5525 versiyalarında mövcuddur.
stories.he: Cisco Secure Email Gateway vulnerability (CVE-2026-76519) actively exploited, CISA adds to KEV catalog

stories.h: CISA 105 eksploit cəhdi qeydə alındığına görə Ivanti Connect Secure sıfır-gün zəifliyini (CVE-2026-104935) KEV kataloquna əlavə edib
stories.s: CISA qeyd edib ki, Ivanti Connect Secure-dəki autentifikasiyanın aşılməsi zəifliyi (CVE-2026-104935) aktiv şəkildə istismar olunur, 105 cəhd müşahidə olunub və 2026-cı ilin 16 oktyabrına qədər pəçləmənin tətbiqi məcburi edilib.
stories.he: CISA adds Ivanti Connect Secure zero‑day (CVE‑2026‑104935) to KEV catalog as 105 exploit attempts logged

stories.h: Critical SonicWall SMA1000 Vulnerability Exploited Within Days of Disclosure
stories.s: Threat actors began exploiting CVE-2026-102255, a pre‑auth SSRF flaw in SonicWall SMA1000 appliances, just two days after its public disclosure on Oct 6, prompting urgent patching of affected models.

stories.h: Critical Bricksforge WordPress Plugin Vulnerability (CVE-2026-85097) Exploited for Unauthenticated RCE
stories.s: Patchstack reports active exploitation of CVE-2026-85097 in Bricksforge plugin versions ≤3.1.8.9, allowing unauthenticated RCE via crafted file uploads; attackers used 63 IPs, with patches released in version 3.1.8.10/4.0.1.

stories.h: AI‑augmented CyberXero campaign steals 628k Ukrainian records via WordPress exploits
stories.s: Russian‑speaking broker CyberXero used Anthropic Claude Code and Cobalt Strike to target WordPress, e‑commerce sites and Ukrainian energy firms, exfiltrating over 628,000 records and compromising sites in Ukraine, Poland, China and the Netherlands.

stories.h: New DarkSword iOS exploit kit variant steals crypto wallet data and adds remote commands
stories.s: Researchers disclosed P7 DarkSword, an iOS exploit kit that extracts keychain, notes, photos and cryptocurrency wallet data, and supports remote commands; it has been seen targeting users in Turkey, Saudi Arabia and other regions.

stories.h: GhostAction campaign injects credential‑stealing GitHub Actions workflows into thousands of repos
stories.s: Researchers report GhostAction used compromised maintainer accounts to push malicious GitHub Actions workflows to over 340 repositories, exfiltrating thousands of secrets including cloud and AI API keys.

stories.h: Researchers Release Exploit for AnyDesk Linux Pre-Auth RCE Vulnerability
stories.s: Security researchers published a working exploit (AnyPwn) for a pre‑authentication heap buffer overflow in AnyDesk Linux 8.0.2 that grants root access, prompting admins to upgrade to version 8.0.3 or later.

stories.h: iRhythm reports breach affecting at least 360,000 patients
stories.s: Medical device maker iRhythm disclosed that a June 8 cyberattack exposed data of at least 360,000 people, including 298,647 in Texas and 69,526 in South Carolina.

stories.h: Critical GitLab CE/EE Vulnerability (CVE-2026-97229) Allows Remote Code Execution
stories.s: GitLab released patches (19.4.2, 19.3.4, 19.2.8) fixing a critical CVE‑2026‑97229 that lets unauthenticated attackers execute code via CI/CD regex overflow, plus 23 other flaws. Upgrade self‑managed instances immediately, especially internet‑facing ones.

stories.h: BotSharp 5.2.0 authentication bypass allows token forgery
stories.s: BotSharp versions up to 5.2.0 have an authentication bypass where attackers can forge bearer tokens using a hard‑coded Jwt:Key in the WebStarter appsettings.json, enabling impersonation of any user, including admins.

stories.h: Chinese-speaking hacker used ARTEX AI and Claude agents to breach South Korean banks
stories.s: A hacker employed the open‑source ARTEX AI penetration testing suite and Claude agents to steal personal and credit‑card data and cause outages at Shinhan Bank, KB Kookmin Bank and Hana Bank, according to CrowdStrike.

stories.h: Zero‑day flaws in AhsayCBS backup software exploited to deploy XMRig miners
stories.s: Threat actors chain two newly disclosed critical CVEs in AhsayCBS to bypass authentication, execute RCE and install Edge‑masquerading XMRig miners; at least five organizations reported compromised since Oct 7, 2026.
